ai_factory_planner_contract_retries.help: Planner calls retried once after an invalid response contract

application_ready_time_seconds.help: Time taken for the application to be ready to service requests

application_started_time_seconds.help: Time taken to start the application

executor_active_threads.help: The approximate number of threads that are actively executing tasks

executor_completed_tasks.help: The approximate total number of tasks that have completed execution

executor_pool_core_threads.help: The core number of threads for the pool

executor_pool_max_threads.help: The maximum allowed number of threads in the pool

executor_pool_size_threads.help: The current number of threads in the pool

executor_queue_remaining_tasks.help: The number of additional elements that this queue can ideally accept without blocking

executor_queued_tasks.help: The approximate number of tasks that are queued for execution

jvm_buffer_count_buffers.help: An estimate of the number of buffers in the pool

jvm_buffer_memory_used_bytes.help: An estimate of the memory that the Java virtual machine is using for this buffer pool

jvm_buffer_total_capacity_bytes.help: An estimate of the total capacity of the buffers in this pool

jvm_classes_loaded_classes.help: The number of classes that are currently loaded in the Java virtual machine

jvm_classes_loaded_count_classes.help: The number of classes loaded in the Java virtual machine

jvm_classes_unloaded_classes.help: The number of classes unloaded in the Java virtual machine

jvm_compilation_time_ms.help: The approximate accumulated elapsed time spent in compilation

jvm_gc_live_data_size_bytes.help: Size of long-lived heap memory pool after reclamation

jvm_gc_max_data_size_bytes.help: Max size of long-lived heap memory pool

jvm_gc_memory_allocated_bytes.help: Incremented for an increase in the size of the (young) heap memory pool after one GC to before the next

jvm_gc_memory_promoted_bytes.help: Count of positive increases in the size of the old generation memory pool before GC to after GC

jvm_gc_overhead.help: An approximation of the percent of CPU time used by GC activities over the last lookback period or since monitoring began, whichever is shorter, in the range [0..1]

jvm_memory_committed_bytes.help: The amount of memory in bytes that is committed for the Java virtual machine to use

jvm_memory_max_bytes.help: The maximum amount of memory in bytes that can be used for memory management

jvm_memory_usage_after_gc.help: The percentage of long-lived heap pool used after the last GC event, in the range [0..1]

jvm_threads_daemon_threads.help: The current number of live daemon threads

jvm_threads_live_threads.help: The current number of live threads including both daemon and non-daemon threads

jvm_threads_peak_threads.help: The peak live thread count since the Java virtual machine started or peak was reset

jvm_threads_started_threads.help: The total number of application threads started in the JVM

logback_events.help: Number of log events that were enabled by the effective log level

process_cpu_time_ns.help: The "cpu time" used by the Java Virtual Machine process

process_cpu_usage.help: The "recent cpu usage" for the Java Virtual Machine process

process_start_time_seconds.help: Start time of the process since unix epoch.

process_uptime_seconds.help: The uptime of the Java virtual machine

system_cpu_count.help: The number of processors available to the Java virtual machine

system_cpu_usage.help: The "recent cpu usage" of the system the application is running in

system_load_average_1m.help: The sum of the number of runnable entities queued to available processors and the number of runnable entities running on the available processors averaged over a period of time
